requirement_text: A patient shall join a teleconsultation for a confirmed online appointment.
An administrator shall deactivate a user account that violates clinic access policy.
A customer shall request a refund for an eligible order.
A seller shall view sales reports for a selected date range.
A bank customer shall delete an inactive beneficiary.
A bank officer shall update the verification status of a customer profile.
A member shall renew an eligible book loan.
A librarian shall deactivate an expired membership.
A lecturer shall schedule an examination for a course.
A student shall register for an examination.
An HR manager shall deactivate an employee account after termination.
An employee shall download an employment confirmation letter.
A traveler shall check in for an eligible flight.
An agent shall review cancelled flight bookings.
A customer shall report a damaged shipment.
A dispatcher shall close a completed delivery order.
